title: Crash When Clicking Scene Root After Opening Material
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible all the time in 4.5-stable, linux

### System information

linux, v4.5-stable, c#, linux

### Issue description

Bug Report: Crash When Clicking Scene Root After Opening Material

Description:
After creating a new scene from an OBJ file and setting up a 100×100 grid, the application consistently crashes when the material editor is opened and the scene root is clicked.

Steps to Reproduce:

Create a new scene from an OBJ file.

Set grid size to 100×100.

Open the material editor.

Click on the scene root.
